observations.bark: Coarse bark coherent; small numerical change, no clear visible gain.
observations.raccoon-fur: Fine weak fur still attenuated; selected gain rises slightly with residual error.
observations.native-grass-wood: Fine low-contrast grass and rail detail remains weak; no clear visual recovery.
observations.main-gfx: All4 regions actually viewed at native160. Sky quiet, larger building/fence coherent, foliage soft; no clear large gain.
observations.extra-mesh: Both regions and both profiles viewed. Nominal erases lattice; nearby profile reveals more diagonal texture, still weak/irregular and similar to V115/V119/V120. Blue point remains.

viewing.reference_scope: Synthetic Commons bark/fur exact retained GT; binned native camera estimates not exact noiseless GT; main3880/extra3835 independent AHD qualitative references never GT.
viewing.scope: V123 midpoint9000 only, not final20000. One fixed draw per CFA; no conditional bias decomposition. Four nominal mainGFX512 contexts and both fixed extra-mesh768 profiles; independent captures not GT. No full427/camera/color/fullframe claim; current recommendation unchanged.
